title: X6857-16.2.0.150SP09-OP004PF001AZ-16.3.0.150SP04-OP004PF001AZ_20260827155936
description:
It is recommended to perform OTA upgrade when the battery is over 50%.

Update Version:
X6857-16.3.0.150SP04(OP004PF001AZ)

Changed Functions:
1. Fully upgraded the NMT (Neural Machine Translation) architecture to significantly improve the accuracy of Chinese speech recognition and the coherence of long-text translation, with support for more advanced semantic understanding.
2. Optimized AI subtitle generation for faster speeds and more accurate syncing with live video streams, improving the cross-language viewing experience.
3. Streamlined system services by rebuilding core services to reduce power consumption, improve performance, extend battery life, and deliver smoother operation.
4. Enhanced cleanup capabilities with deeper system junk scanning to free up storage more accurately.
5. Updated Google Security Patch to August 2026 to enhance system security.

Fixed Issues:
1. Fixed issues in AI Gallery where Memories albums could fail to open properly, background music could fail to play, sub-albums could show a white screen, and full-resolution images could load incorrectly.
2. Fixed display issues with resizable icons and improved Launcher stability after home screen restoration on the following day, making long-term use more reliable.
3. Fixed touch responsiveness issues in parts of the notification bar to improve interaction responsiveness.

Reminding:
1. Optimized system stability and performance while fixing other issues.
2. Visit the XClub forum (https://www.infinix.club) for more information.
